name: textplot
description: ASCII and Unicode plots inline in DuckDB query results — bars, sparklines, and density plots that fit in a single VARCHAR column. Useful for eyeballing distributions and trends in the DuckDB CLI without leaving the terminal.

cta.title: Charts in Your SELECT Statement
cta.description: Install Textplot to render bars, sparklines, and density plots inline in any DuckDB query — no notebook, no BI tool, just SQL output.
